articles.title: Quiet news day for Jackson County (2026-06-14)
articles.lede: Public RSS sweeps turned up no fresh Jackson County items in the last 24 hours.
articles.body_md:
The daily generator scans more than a dozen public RSS feeds (Indianapolis, Louisville, Bloomington and Columbus broadcasters, plus the National Weather Service) every morning at 06:20.

Today no items matched Jackson County, Seymour, Brownstown, Crothersville, Medora, or any of the local ZIP codes. That can mean a genuinely slow news day, or that broadcasters did not tag a Jackson story with a recognizable town name. The generator will re-run tomorrow.

In the meantime, the rolling /news page (above) still pulls fresh Indiana headlines every two hours via the TCG Seymour news API.
